assets.name: 연못 정원
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: detailed vertical 2D pinball game BACKGROUND illustration for "연못 정원". Primary request: a jade-green Korean pond garden seen directly from above: detailed lotus leaves and pale blossoms, fine reeds, smooth river pebbles, weathered stone stepping stones and tiny koi near the SIDE MARGINS, delicate water ripples and floating petals. Pale sage, celadon, warm cream and muted gold. Hand-painted engraved storybook game art matching tactile illustrated brass/wood/stone obstacle sprites. Portrait 2:3 canvas. Orthographic overhead, no perspective vanishing point or horizon. Fill the whole frame, opaque background. Keep the central 60 percent broad, quiet, softly textured and low contrast so small colored marbles and physical obstacles remain clearly readable on top. Place the richest environmental details in the outer 20 percent on each side, with subtle smaller details rather than large focal objects. Top and bottom edges should have neutral matching tones and no clipped focal objects, suitable for vertically mirrored repetition during a long scrolling game. Background scenery only: no pinball, no marbles, no UI, no text, no logo, no numbers, no collision-looking barriers across the center, no game obstacles, no frame border, no strong cast shadows. Cohesive refined palette and abundant tiny crafted details, not an empty gradient.
